subject: general
question: Which river originates from the southern part of Devarayanadurga hill in Tumkur district, and flows for about 221 km before joining Kaveri?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shimsha River.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Shimsha River originates from the southern part of Devarayanadurga hill in Tumkur district, Karnataka.**
 
• ** It is a tributary of the Kaveri River and flows for about 221 km before joining Kaveri.**
 
• Shimsha River is known for its** scenic beauty** and is a popular spot for fishing and boating.
 
• Cauvery River rises at Talakaveri on the Brahmagiri range in the Western Ghats in the state of Karnataka.
 
• It flows for about 800 km before it falls into the Bay of Bengal.
 
 
• Left bank tributaries:-__
 __
 
• Harangi, Hemavati, Shimsha, and Arkavati*.*
 
 
 
• Right bank tributaries:-__
 __
 
• Lakshmantirtha, Kabbani, Suvarnavati, Bhavani, Noyil, and Amaravati.
 
 
 
 
 
• Cauvery basin extends over an area of 87,900 sq. km. which is nearly 2.7% of the total geographical area of the country.
 
• The Cauvery basin extends over the states of Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala, and the Union Territory of Puducherry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Girna River** is a tributary of the **Tapti River in Maharashtra,**
 
• **Ghataprabha River** is a tributary of the **Krishna River in Karnataka.**
 
• ** Waghur River **is a tributary of the **Godavari River in Maharashtra.**
